title: Seed the shell principal from '/': one tenant+caps fact replaces three GETs
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: the seed is threaded as ShellPrincipalContext (provided by Workspace) AND primed into the module from a useState initializer; useCapabilities(principal?) uses capabilitiesServerSnapshot(seed) as its server snapshot and capabilitiesSnapshot(seed) (module value ?? seed) as its client snapshot - the same array identity, so no hydration mismatch and no GET on a seeded document. Workspace passes its own prop because it provides the context and cannot read it. The capabilities fetch fallback moved from useCapabilities.ts into shellPrincipal.ts (ensureShellCapabilities, injectable fetcher), still via sharedGetJson so useSessionLapse keeps coalescing when unseeded. primeRecentsWorkspace (zero callers) was deleted; primePreviewScope kept (its clear-on-new-tenant test). previewCache.test.ts not edited (its cases stay green unchanged). Two docs, not one: app-structure.md (the shell's coupled doc) AND docs/features/pipeline/README.md, whose usePipelineTenant paragraph would otherwise state the removed GET as fact (the map couples app/features/hiring/pipeline/** to it). Tests and implementation landed in one feat commit (a test-only commit would have been red on 8 of 8 - the module did not exist).
notes: useCapabilities consumers, all seeded on first render: Workspace.tsx (explicit prop), WorkspaceNavDrawer/NavSectionRail via Workspace's capabilities prop, WorkspaceCommandPalette.tsx, insights/about/AboutTab.tsx, settings/models/ModelsQualityOverview.tsx (the last three read ShellPrincipalContext). The branding nav gate (TAB_CAPABILITY branding:org:manage) is served by the same seeded set. setupSeat.ts (r07 wizard) reads GET /api/me/onboarding, not useCapabilities - unchanged, still fails open on an unknown seat. Open/dev mode: callerCapabilities() folds to OWNER_CAPS, so the seed locks nothing; a page.tsx resolve failure seeds null = the old fetch path. The deep-link pages (/jds/[slug], /history/[slug]) are unseeded and use one shared deduped GET /api/workspaces + one GET /api/me/capabilities. Server safety: primeShellPrincipal is a no-op without window; the server render reads the seed only through context. Request count on '/': GET /api/workspaces 3 -> 0; GET /api/me/capabilities 1 -> 1 (useSessionLapse now issues it on its own instead of riding useCapabilities' read). A caller without `read` now gets tenant-scoped recents/board storage (the seed is their own session's workspace; /api/workspaces used to 403 them). PERF: measured on git archive of 1e52a019f with/without only this card's 7 source files: 1440/9155.4 KB -> 1441/9161.9 KB (+1 module/+6.5 KB); raised app/page.tsx 1433/9139 -> 1434/9146 under the lock with a why. test:perf remains red on FOREIGN growth only: the journey-cohort commit 1e52a019f landed +7 modules/~16 KB on app/page.tsx without a raise, sibling uncommitted files add the rest of the KB, and hire-from-need +1 KB is a sibling's (237 modules on base and mine alike). tsc: clean except errors under the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (another session's copy of an old main, not in any tsconfig exclusion) - foreign. Full test:unit: 2 BROKEN, both foreign in-flight sibling files (app/_lib/floor-move-preview.test.ts untracked, app/api/analytics/analytics-writes-authority.test.ts modified-uncommitted); floor-move-preview passed on re-run. workspace-shell-core/B: Workspace.tsx now has a `principal` prop, a useState prime line, and the whole return wrapped in <ShellPrincipalContext.Provider> - B's panelFor wiring can read capabilities from the existing `capabilities` const.
